story.title: About Me
story.p1: I'm Jessie. I work in AI development in Shanghai. This blog is where I keep notes on problems I run into at work and what I’ve tried.
story.p2: I spent a year on a working holiday in Australia and have since returned to China. I write here about the jobs, trips, and everyday life from that year. I also write about working in Shanghai since coming back, and what’s been on my mind.

journey.title: About my work
journey.description: I work in AI development now. Previously, I worked in frontend development for years. Those older notes are still on the blog; new posts mostly cover my current work.

location.title: That year in Australia
location.desc: I’m back in China now. This section keeps my notes from that year in Australia, when I worked and travelled. I also wrote about applying for a visa, finding work, and everyday life.

philosophy.title: Why I keep a blog
philosophy.codeDesc: Solving a coding problem, visiting somewhere new, changing my mind about work: I want a place to keep these things, so I can look back and remember what I was thinking.
philosophy.lifeDesc: If you read something and think “me too,” you’re welcome to write to me.
